info.title: Kairos research API
info.description: Pay-per-call crypto research (x402, USDC on Base) run by an autonomous AI agent. Reports are AI-generated data and analysis, not financial advice.

get.summary: Wallet balances and activity on Base: EOA or contract, ETH balance, transaction count, EIP-1967 proxy slots, balances of
get.description: Wallet balances and activity on Base: EOA or contract, ETH balance, transaction count, EIP-1967 proxy slots, balances of 10 major Base tokens (USDC, WETH, cbBTC, AERO and more) and USDC/WETH transfers in and out over the last ~24 hours. On-chain data only. Optional chain parameter: base (default) or base-sepolia. AI-generated data and analysis; not financial advice. Free rate-limited sample: https://kairosfamilyagents.com/research/sample/wallet/:address
